summary: Returns a new list of orders from the internal collection whose customer_id equals the provided customer_id.
inputs: customer_id (str): Target customer identifier used to filter orders.
self.orders (Mapping[Any, Order]): Internal mapping of orders; its values() are iterated to access order objects.
outputs: orders_by_customer (List[Order]): New list containing orders whose order.customer_id equals the provided customer_id.
main_effect: Construct a list from the filtered orders
side_effects: orders_by_customer (List[Order]): New list containing orders whose order.customer_id equals the provided customer_id.
errors: An order object is missing the customer_id attribute during filtering
AttributeError: Encountered an order without a customer_id attribute while filtering.
AttributeError: The orders collection does not implement a values() method.
The orders container does not support attribute values()
